field.name: smtp2go_api_site_id
field.label: SMTP2GO API site
field.description: Select the #__ra_api_sites record used to connect to SMTP2GO
field.query: SELECT id AS value, CONCAT(title, ' (', id, ')') AS text FROM #__ra_api_sites WHERE state=1 ORDER BY title

field.name: smtp2go_subaccount_name
field.label: SMTP2GO sub-account name
field.description: Name validated by Step 7 and awaiting final provisioning in Step 8

field.name: smtp2go_subaccount_id
field.label: SMTP2GO sub-account ID
field.description: Provider ID saved after successful provisioning in Step 8

field.name: smtp2go_sender_registration
field.label: SMTP2GO sender verification
field.description: Sender verification method selected in Step 7 of the Installation Wizard
field.option: Single Sender Email and Sender Domain

field.name: sender_email
field.label: Sending user
field.description: Email address to be used as Sender

field.name: note1
field.label: You must set up a scheduled Task: php joomla.php ra_delivery:pollactivity

field.name: event_types
field.label: Monitored event types
field.description: Select SMTP2GO activity events to ingest. Unsubscribe and resubscribe events are intentionally excluded.

field.name: lookback_minutes
field.label: Overlap lookback in minutes
field.description: Minutes to subtract from the stored watermark to avoid missing late-arriving events

field.name: page_limit
field.label: Events per page
field.description: Maximum events to request per activity search call

field.name: tidy_up_days
field.label: Tidy-up retention days
field.description: Optional retention period. After polling completes, stored event rows older than this many days will be deleted

field.name: notify_user
field.label: Who is to be notified of exceptions
field.description: Joomla user to be notified of delivery exceptions
field.query: SELECT u.id AS value, c.name AS text FROM #__users AS u INNER JOIN #__contact_details AS c ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE u.block = 0 AND c.published = 1 UNION SELECT 0, '--Select Contact --' ORDER BY text
